parameter_status.mass_kg: sum of x500_base inertial masses; no payload
parameter_status.rotor_radius_m: proxy from rotor collision-box half-length, not aerodynamic measurement
parameter_status.remaining_parameters: explicit illustrative assumptions; not calibrated to x500 electrical measurements

limitations: Quasi-steady level-flight formula with illustrative hover split and drag coefficient.
Added positive gravitational and kinetic work proxies; no regeneration credit.
No wind, vortex-ring-state model, thrust-margin proof, battery voltage or SOC dynamics.
Airborne reference mission only: excludes launch, landing, feedback waits and failsafes.
